notes: A 20-minute tram or bus ticket costs 4 PLN, a day ticket 17 PLN; the Old Town is walkable. The airport train costs 17 PLN. Go to Auschwitz, Wieliczka and Zakopane by bus or tour (Auschwitz tour 150-200 PLN).

In December a Christmas market is set up on the Rynek (one of Europe's best). Winter temperatures are around -5°C with snow; you can ski in Zakopane. April-May and September are ideal; Auschwitz is heavy in any season.
Pierogi cost 25-35 PLN, zapiekanka 15, obwarzanek 3, a milk bar meal 20, beer 12; tip 10%. Poland is cheap and cards are accepted everywhere.

An online guided ticket (90 PLN) is MANDATORY for Auschwitz; free entry is available before 07:30 and in the evening. Not recommended under 14. Buy online tickets for Schindler's Factory and Wieliczka; museums have restricted access on Mondays.
Wawel State Rooms have timed entry. The St Mary's altarpiece opens at 12:00. The hejnał is played to four directions every hour.
Vodka: żubrówka with apple juice (szarlotka). At night in Kazimierz, head to Plac Nowy.

stops.name: Rynek Główny
stops.tips: Europe's largest medieval square. The St Mary's bugle call (hejnał) breaks off mid-note every hour.

stops.name: St. Mary's Basilica
stops.tips: Veit Stoss's wooden altarpiece opens at 12:00. The tower costs 15 PLN.

stops.name: Rynek Underground Museum
stops.tips: Medieval Krakow beneath the square. Multimedia displays, closed Tuesdays, book online.

stops.name: Przystanek Pierogarnia
stops.tips: Handmade pierogi (ruskie, mushroom). It's on Bonerowska.

stops.name: Wawel Royal Castle & Cathedral
stops.tips: The royal castle. State Rooms 35 PLN (online), cathedral with the Sigismund Bell and royal tombs 25, Dragon's Den, courtyard free.

backups.name: Bar Mleczny Pod Temidą
backups.tips: A milk bar (bar mleczny) on Grodzka. Cheap Polish home cooking.

backups.name: Collegium Maius
backups.tips: Copernicus's university. Courtyard and clock show at 13:00.

stops.name: Old Synagogue Kazimierz
stops.tips: Poland's oldest synagogue (15th century). Museum inside, on Szeroka Square.

stops.name: Plac Nowy Zapiekanka
stops.tips: Zapiekanka (half-baguette pizza) from the windows of the Round Market. Endzior is the classic.

stops.name: Schindler's Factory Museum
stops.tips: Krakow under Nazi occupation. Book online (sells out), restricted on Mondays, in Podgórze.

stops.name: Ghetto Heroes Square Chairs
stops.tips: A memorial of 70 empty chairs. Nearby is the Eagle Pharmacy Museum (Pod Orłem).

stops.name: Bernatka Footbridge & Vistula
stops.tips: A suspension footbridge and the riverside promenade. Walk back to Kazimierz.

backups.name: Hamsa Kazimierz
backups.tips: Israeli cuisine and hummus, on Szeroka.

backups.name: MOCAK Museum of Contemporary Art
backups.tips: Contemporary art next to the factory. A good option if you have no Schindler ticket.

stops.name: Auschwitz I
stops.tips: Bus or tour takes 1.5 hours (70 km). A guided tour is MANDATORY between 10:00 and 16:00 (book online weeks ahead, 90 PLN). See the 'Arbeit macht frei' gate, the blocks and the gas chamber. Not recommended under 14.

stops.name: Auschwitz II Birkenau
stops.tips: A shuttle covers the 3 km. See the ramp, barracks ruins and the site where 1.5 million victims died. Keep silent.

stops.name: Oświęcim Town Restaurant
stops.tips: A quiet lunch in town. The Auschwitz Jewish Center (synagogue) is optional.

stops.name: Planty Park Evening Walk
stops.tips: On your return to Krakow, walk the park that rings the Old Town. A chance to breathe.

backups.name: Auschwitz Jewish Center
backups.tips: The town's surviving synagogue and its museum.

backups.name: Restauracja Starka Kazimierz
backups.tips: Homemade vodka and duck in the evening.

days.theme: Wieliczka Salt Mine and Nowa Huta

stops.name: Wieliczka Salt Mine
stops.tips: 20 minutes by train. A salt cathedral 135 m underground, chandeliers, 800 steps (lift back up), 14°C. Book online (foreign-language tour about 140 PLN).

stops.name: Karczma Halit Wieliczka
stops.tips: A karczma (inn) next to the mine. Try żurek (sour rye soup) and placki (potato pancakes).

stops.name: Nowa Huta Central Square
stops.tips: A Stalinist ideal city (1949). Take tram 22 to see socialist realist boulevards and the Ark Church.

stops.name: Stylowa Restaurant Nowa Huta
stops.tips: A communist-era restaurant unchanged since 1956.

backups.name: Nowa Huta Museum
backups.tips: A bunker and an exhibition on communism.

stops.name: Krupówki Street Zakopane
stops.tips: 2 hours by bus (FlixBus/Majer). The main street of the mountain town, with oscypek (smoked sheep's cheese) stalls.

stops.name: Gubałówka Funicular
stops.tips: 1,120 m. Tatra panorama, hiking in summer, skiing in winter.

stops.name: Karczma Zapiecek Zakopane
stops.tips: A Górale (highlander) inn. Try kwaśnica soup and oscypek with cranberry jam.

stops.name: Morskie Oko
stops.tips: In winter, a frozen lake and snowy road (2.5 hours). Bring ice grips for your shoes, or take a horse-drawn sleigh.

stops.name: Willa Koliba Museum of Zakopane Style
stops.tips: Witkiewicz's wooden villa. Zakopane architecture, return bus at 19:30.

backups.name: Kasprowy Wierch Cable Car
backups.tips: Cable car to the 1,987 m summit. An alternative to Morskie Oko (book online).

backups.name: Bąkowa Zohylina Zakopane
backups.tips: A well-known Górale inn with live music.

stops.name: Barbican & Florian Gate
stops.tips: A medieval city gate and barbican. Floriańska Street, the start of the Royal Route.

stops.name: Czartoryski Museum
stops.tips: Da Vinci's Lady with an Ermine, plus Rembrandt's landscape. Free on Tuesdays.

stops.name: Kościuszko Mound
stops.tips: A memorial hill from 1823. Views of the city and the Tatras. Take tram 1 and walk; fort museum on site.

stops.name: Pod Baranem
stops.tips: An Old Town Polish classic. Duck and pierogi.

stops.name: Kazimierz Evening Alchemia
stops.tips: A candlelit Kazimierz bar. Plac Nowy, live jazz.

backups.name: Kraków Zoo & Las Wolski
backups.tips: A zoo in the forest. An alternative to the hill.

backups.name: Chimera Salad Bar
backups.tips: A vegetarian buffet on Św. Anny. Cheap.

stops.name: Wawel Dragon Statue
stops.tips: A dragon that breathes fire every 5 minutes, on the Vistula bank.

stops.name: Vistula Boulevards Walk
stops.tips: The riverside promenade. Coffee boats in summer, views of Wawel.

stops.name: Café Camelot
stops.tips: A bohemian Old Town café. Try the apple charlotte as a farewell treat.

stops.name: Obwarzanek Stand
stops.tips: The Krakow bagel-like ring (UNESCO-listed). Choose poppy seed or salted.

stops.name: Kraków Główny Airport Train
stops.tips: The train to Balice takes 20 minutes. Farewell.

backups.name: Massolit Books & Café
backups.tips: An English-language bookshop café. Try the cheesecake.

backups.name: Manggha Museum
backups.tips: Japanese art, across the Vistula. An alternative to the boulevard walk.
